capabilities: copy text inside inline code, bold, italic, or highlighted formatting
copy internal links to headings with the heading text as display text
generate a random or manual block ID and copy the block link
customize which copy targets are enabled
disambiguation: Not a clipboard manager; it copies only the text or link at the current cursor position.
extras: No default hotkey is assigned due to Obsidian limitations; the user must assign one to the "Easy Copy: Contextual Copy" command. Installable via BRAT.
motivation: The author often used inline code for debug commands and keywords and found manually selecting the text inside the backticks tedious, so they created the plugin for one-keystroke copying.
problem: Copying the text inside Markdown formatting requires carefully selecting around the symbols, and generating block links means manually creating block IDs and unwieldy links.
summary: Contextual copy command that copies the inner text of inline code, bold, italic, or highlighted text, and copies or generates heading and block links.
